title: Arc announcement strip
description: A 56px near-black strip above the header with one centred line of news and a link with a thin arrow; on phones the link drops to a second line. The link dims and its arrow nudges right on hover.
notes: always dark: it puts the `dark` class on itself, so it uses the theme's dark background
name: arc-announcement

props.name: message
props.description: the news line, e.g. "Basin now holds cash for 2,000 startups."
